name: class-test-31d1ee9eb5/distinct-class-def-v.bal
spec_references: Module-level declarations: Class definition — Supports `client`, `service`, `isolated`, `readonly` and `distinct` `class-type-quals`

reason: The essential `type Circle distinct object` declaration uses a distinct object-type qualifier, excluded by the restriction allowing only client, service and isolated object-type qualifiers. Runtime assertions require that distinct identity to survive inclusion into ColoredCircle and ColoredCirclePlus and reject the structural lookalike. This decisive unsupported construct makes the whole case a feature. Separately, distinct class coverage conflicts between the positive class list and the class qualifier restriction.
unsupported_constructs: `type Circle distinct object` (excluded by object qualifier restriction)
test_design_notes: main runs both assignability and runtime type-identity assertions; correct execution requires every assertion to pass without panic. No @args, @panic, or @output directives occur.
The assertion helper uses supported value:toString method syntax; it introduces no separate langlib exclusion.
